subject.title: Feature/Fix: Profile and optimize shadow lineage accounting

question: After https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2153 lands, should this final slice be accepted as shadow-only infrastructure despite remaining day-level lineage error and parser-cache invalidation?
rationale: The implementation deliberately avoids changing the default totals, but accepting a large internal scanner architecture and its upgrade rescan cost is a maintainer ownership decision rather than a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Land shadow-only after targeted upgrade proof
options.body: Refresh the branch after its prerequisite, confirm cache invalidation, cancellation, and legacy-default behavior on the exact head, then merge without promoting lineage authority.

options.title: Hold for broader accuracy validation
options.body: Keep the stack in draft until additional real histories reduce the remaining per-day discrepancies and discovery/loading constraints.

recommendation.title: Land shadow-only after targeted upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch after its prerequisite, confirm cache invalidation, cancellation, and legacy-default behavior on the exact head, then merge without promoting lineage authority.

likelyOwner.reason: The canonical investigation, central scanner history, and prior Phase 1 merge all point to steipete as the best available owner for the architecture and rollout decision.
